name: Open Gauges
blurb: Stepper, NeoPixel and analogue gauges that display live data — wind speed, pressure, anything on MQTT.

name: Fenland
blurb: A weeWX skin with live dashboard, multi-model ensemble, forecast verification and 86-year climatology.

name: Ships Lamp Wind Speed Gauge
blurb: A strip of NeoPixels inside a ship's lamp, flickering like an oil flame at a rate set by live wind speed.

name: The Hour
blurb: Printable files and code to make a timekeeping marble run.

name: Literary Clock
blurb: A crowdsourced database of literary quotes, one for every minute, published to an open MQTT feed any device can subscribe to.

name: MQTT Scroller
blurb: A Hub75 LED matrix driven by a Pimoroni Interstate75W, scrolling whatever arrives on MQTT — time, news, environmental data.

name: Lightsaber Wind Gauge
blurb: 144 NeoPixels inside a diffused sabre blade: the glow climbs and changes colour with wind speed, with a red marker for the day's peak gust.

name: Just Weather
blurb: A Pebble watch face using Open-Meteo: forecast, pressure trend and nothing else.

name: AllSky Camera
blurb: A 3D printed case for a Pi HQ camera and fisheye lens, shooting all-night star trails and all-day timelapses into Home Assistant.

name: Weather House
blurb: Python, laser cut and 3D printed weather house driven by live station data.

name: Radiation Shield
blurb: A printable Stevenson-screen substitute for the WeatherFlow Air — six parts that slide together without glue or fixings.

name: VibeABM
blurb: A collection of agent based models created through vibe coding.

name: THE
blurb: eInk mini MQTT display for time, headlines and environmental data.
